title: Review
intro: Let’s go over what we learned about good character, family and neighbours, and what harms a person.

items: How do we look after our life and health?
What belongs to a good work ethic?
What was the first command Allah (SWT) gave to people? (Hint: the first word revealed of the Qur’an was “Iqra’!” – “Read!”)
What does kindness to parents (birr al-walidayn) include?

learn.text: Write what you have learned about…

learn.title: The neighbour
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “By Allah, he is not a believer! By Allah, he is not a believer! By Allah, he is not a believer!” They asked: “Who, O Messenger of Allah?” He said: “The one whose neighbour is not safe from his harm.” (Bukhari)

learn.title: Young and old
learn.html: “Whoever does not show mercy to our young, does not respect our elders and does not recognise the right of our scholars is not one of us.”

learn.title: Say it and stay on it
learn.html: One of the Companions asked Muhammad (SAW): “O Messenger of Allah, tell me something about Islam that I will never need to ask anyone else about after you.” He said: “Say: I believe in Allah, then be steadfast.” (Muslim)

learn.title: Backbiting (ghibah)
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “Backbiting is mentioning your brother with something he dislikes.” The Companions asked: “What if what I say is true about him?” He said: “If it is true, you have backbitten him, and if it is not, you have slandered him.” (Muslim)

learn.title: Pride
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “No one who has even an atom’s weight of pride in his heart will enter Jannah.” A man said: “But a person loves his clothes and shoes to be nice.” The Prophet (SAW) said: “Allah is beautiful and loves beauty. Pride is rejecting the truth and looking down on people.” (Muslim)

learn.title: Patience (sabr)
learn.html: Patience means bearing life’s hardships with dignity and courage, without falling into fear and panic when trouble or illness comes. Patience is a Muslim’s strength in the struggle through life and its tests.

learn.title: Animals
learn.html: We are forbidden to cause pain to other living beings, except in real need. We may remove pests, but we may not torture any animal or burn it with fire, because that is a great sin.
